description: This file contains unit tests for helper functions related to execution approval reply handling in a TypeScript project. The tests cover payload construction, parsing, validation, and message formatting for an approval system integrated via different chat platforms.

methods.name: getExecApprovalApproverDmNoticeText
methods.description: Returns a message indicating that approval DMs have been sent to approvers.

methods.name: buildExecApprovalUnavailableReplyPayload
methods.description: Creates a payload indicating that exec approval is unavailable, with specific reason texts.

methods.name: getExecApprovalReplyMetadata
methods.description: Extracts and normalizes approval metadata from reply payloads, filtering invalid entries.

methods.name: buildExecApprovalPendingReplyPayload
methods.description: Constructs a reply payload with approval request details, including command snippets, expiration, and metadata.

methods.name: buildExecApprovalActionDescriptors
methods.description: Generates descriptors for approval decision actions (allow once, always, deny).

methods.name: buildExecApprovalInteractiveReply
methods.description: Creates an interactive reply structure with buttons for decision choices.

methods.name: buildExecApprovalCommandText
methods.description: Builds command strings for executing approval decisions.

methods.name: parseExecApprovalCommandText
methods.description: Parses command strings to extract approval ID and decision.
